covered_report_window.description: U.S.-listed companies reporting after the U.S. market close on Tuesday, October 6, 2026, plus companies reporting before the U.S. market open on Wednesday, October 7, 2026

market_context_summary: U.S. equities were near record highs at midday, while the 10-year Treasury yield remained above 5.2% and oil was volatile. FOMC minutes are due October 7 at 2:00 p.m. ET, after the immediate earnings reaction window.

methodology.consensus_basis: Arithmetic mean of independent Pass A, Pass B, and Pass C direction scores and reversal-risk values
methodology.disparity_definition: Rounded average of the range of the three direction scores and the range of the three reversal-risk values, on a 0-100 scale

top_setups.note: Only one company cleared the directional threshold on the upside; no second or third upward setup met the evidence bar.

ranked_companies.timing: 2026-10-06 after market close; call 4:30 p.m. ET
ranked_companies.expected_driver: FY2027 AI/memory revenue durability and gross margin
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: High whisper bar; 19% implied move; valuation
ranked_companies.method_update_note: Priced-in premium-growth penalty applied; no new rule
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Record AI and integrated-memory momentum supports upside, but the stock needs a strong FY2027 outlook to clear an elevated bar.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is approximately $0.77 EPS and $521 million revenue; options price roughly a 19%-20% move.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: FY2027 AI and memory outlook extends the Q3 acceleration with margin resilience.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A merely in-line outlook, weaker mix, or cash-flow concerns trigger a valuation reset.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Approximately 19%-20% implied move, 13.8% short interest reported by OptionSlam, and strong prior event volatility.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Recent consensus is bullish overall, including a Stifel target increase to $75, but target dispersion is wide.

key_sources.title: Penguin Solutions Q3 FY2026 SEC exhibit

ranked_companies.timing: 2026-10-06 after market close; call 4:30 p.m. ET
ranked_companies.expected_driver: Core growth and adjusted EBITDA versus Q1 guide
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Investor Day relief; low bar; divestiture progress
ranked_companies.method_update_note: Same-day/product-quality headline check applied; no new rule
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Turnaround evidence is improving, but a tight Q1 guide, divestiture uncertainty, leverage, and the HYCOAT contamination issue leave more downside than upside surprise capacity.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Management guided to $207-$209 million revenue and about $37 million adjusted EBITDA; published EPS consensus is about $0.05.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Food Safety growth, supply normalization, and Investor Day targets validate a durable recovery.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Core growth or EBITDA misses, genomics delay, or expanded product-quality exposure undercut credibility.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Reliable after-close event pricing was not available; one calendar source incorrectly labeled the report pre-market.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Revenue estimates edged higher, but EPS revisions and price-target signals were mixed to weaker.

key_sources.title: Neogen Q4 FY2026 results and FY2027 guidance

ranked_companies.timing: 2026-10-06 after market close; call 2026-10-07 10:00 a.m. ET
ranked_companies.expected_driver: Adjusted NII/dividend coverage and NAV stability
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Deep NAV discount; low bar; credit relief
ranked_companies.method_update_note: Low-bar reversal-risk floor applied; no new rule
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: The prior quarter's NII shortfall and NAV erosion keep the base case negative, although the large discount to NAV creates substantial relief-rally risk.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Published estimates center near $0.49-$0.54 adjusted EPS/NII and roughly $31-$32 million revenue.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: NII coverage, NAV, and non-accruals stabilize enough to validate the discounted valuation.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Another coverage gap, NAV write-down, or credit deterioration raises dividend concern.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options evidence is thin; the stock is deeply de-rated and carries an unusually high indicated yield.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Coverage is sparse and generally Hold; consensus quality is lower than for the larger names.

ranked_companies.timing: 2026-10-06 after market close; call 2026-10-07 8:00 a.m. ET
ranked_companies.expected_driver: Beer depletions and beer operating margin
ranked_companies.method_update_note: Key-metric and low-bar relief checks applied; no new rule
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Soft summer consumption and lower beer-margin estimates tilt negative, but low valuation and reduced expectations limit conviction.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $3.55-$3.62 EPS and $2.54-$2.57 billion revenue; options price roughly a 5% move.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Beer depletions stabilize, margin holds, and FY2027 guidance remains intact.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Demand softness, aluminum inflation, or a guide cut overwhelms share gains and cash returns.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Nearest-expiry implied move is approximately 4.8%-5.9%, with slightly call-heavy open interest in one snapshot.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Consensus EPS moved down slightly and several firms cut price targets on softer consumption and beer margins.

ranked_companies.timing: 2026-10-06 after market close; call 2026-10-07 8:30 a.m. ET
ranked_companies.expected_driver: Kloeckner integration and value-added spread quality
ranked_companies.method_update_note: Acquisition hidden-risk check applied; no new rule
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Kloeckner creates a credible synergy path, but near-term spread compression, legal-control timing, and integration accounting make the immediate reaction too hard to call.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Published consensus is about $0.92 EPS and $2.01 billion revenue; options snapshots indicate roughly 6%-11% near-term event risk.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Early integration proof and synergy timing outweigh legacy spread pressure.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Weak spreads, electrical-steel demand, acquisition costs, or leverage dominate the strategic story.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options estimates vary materially across sources, reducing signal quality.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Sparse coverage and transformational acquisition accounting limit the usefulness of consensus comparisons.

research_allocation_view.reason: No name simultaneously had an absolute consensus score above 30, reversal risk at or below 40, and sufficient confidence.
